items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And of course, Bob Burk singing, 'It's Another One of Those Songs'.

ctx.x: New York City. Yeah, this was later on. And I had 'Trees' in my repertoire and I was going to do it, but the manager came back after the first show and said, you can't sing 'Trees' because you got, 'only God could make a tree' in it and you couldn't use the word 'God' on the stage at the time. I don't know. You can do a lot of things that we couldn't do back in 1938 and '37. But I had to take 'Trees' our of my repertoire and that was my big number. And of course, Bob Burk singing, 'It's Another One of Those Songs'.
Oh, by the way just before we get onto that I was also reading in the book Earl Hines today that Lois Deppe makes the claim that he was the first person to sing 'Trees' on the radio.
